description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Salesforce CPQ & Billing Developer based in the United States . 

 We are seeking an experienced Salesforce CPQ & Billing Developer to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions within complex Quote-to-Cash environments. In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise to optimize product configuration, pricing, quoting, subscription management, and billing processes. You will build customized Salesforce solutions, develop advanced pricing logic, and integrate enterprise systems to support seamless business operations. Working closely with architects, business analysts, product owners, and engineering teams, you will translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. This opportunity offers the chance to contribute to complex digital transformation initiatives in a collaborative, technology-driven environment. 



Accountabilities:
 

 
 
 
 Configure, develop, test, and deploy Salesforce CPQ and Salesforce Billing solutions to support end-to-end business processes. 







 
 
 
 Design and maintain product configurations, pricing rules, discounting logic, quote templates, and automated quoting workflows. 







 
 
 
 Develop advanced pricing functionality using the Quote Calculator Plugin (QCP) and implement custom solutions using Apex, including classes, triggers, batch jobs, and asynchronous processing. 







 
 
 
 Build and maintain REST API integrations to enable reliable data exchange between Salesforce and external enterprise systems. 







 
 
 
 Support Conga Composer and other document generation solutions, including template development and customization. 







 
 
 
 Manage complex Quote-to-Cash scenarios involving subscriptions, amendments, renewals, contract lifecycles, order management, and billing workflows. 







 
 
 
 Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 







 
 
 
 Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, effort estimation, and sprint planning. 







 
 
 
 Perform unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing support to ensure solution quality and reliability. 







 
 
 
 Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and continuously improve platform performance and functionality. 







 
 
 
 Support DevOps and cloud-related operational activities, including deployment automation, configuration management, security controls, monitoring, and documentation. 







 
 
 
 Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and deployment standards while collaborating with engineering and operations teams. 








 Requirements: 


 
 
 
 10+ years of professional experience working with the Salesforce platform, including extensive hands-on development and customization experience. 







 
 
 
 Strong practical expertise in Salesforce CPQ and Salesforce Billing, particularly in complex enterprise environments. 







 
 
 
 Advanced experience with Quote Calculator Plugin (QCP) and the development of sophisticated pricing and quoting logic. 







 
 
 
 Proficiency in Apex development, including classes, triggers, batch processing, and asynchronous operations. 







 
 
 
 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing REST API integrations and supporting enterprise data flows. 







 
 
 
 Strong understanding of the complete Quote-to-Cash lifecycle, including quoting, order management, contract management, provisioning, subscription management, invoicing, and usage tracking. 







 
 
 
 Knowledge of pricing strategies, product configuration, discounting models, and contract lifecycle management within CPQ platforms. 







 
 
 
 Experience with Salesforce CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and DevOps best practices. 







 
 
 
 Familiarity with Conga Composer or comparable document generation tools. 







 
 
 
 Understanding of subscription-based and usage-based billing models. 







 
 
 
 Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and operational practices, including security, identity management, networking, monitoring, backup, and availability. 







 
 
 
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, with excellent attention to detail. 







 
 
 
 Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and contribute to cross-functional teams. 







 
 
 
 Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple technical priorities effectively. 








 Benefits: 


 
 
 
 Fully remote working opportunity within the United States. 







 
 
 
 Contract-based engagement. 







 
 
 
 Opportunity to work on complex Salesforce CPQ and Billing implementations. 







 
 
 
 Exposure to enterprise-scale Quote-to-Cash solutions and advanced Salesforce technologies. 







 
 
 
 Collaborative environment involving architects, developers, business analysts, and product teams. 







 
 
 
 Opportunities to expand technical expertise and contribute to challenging digital transformation initiatives. 







 
 
 
 Professional growth through exposure to enterprise integrations, automation, and DevOps practices.
